item: Articles that mention a date and per-mention confirm/reject/undo (Lane M rows)
summary: A picked day and each deduced event open the articles that mention that date (GET /api/article-dates/by-date), each with the sentence the date was read from and a local-reader link. Confirm or Reject changes that one date tag; Undo puts back the status it had (new POST /api/article-dates/{id}/reset). The never-confirmed caveat stays visible above the list. Three feature rows leave routes_without_ui.tsv and the ceiling drops 68 -> 65.
